title: Bayesian Nonparametric Dynamical Clustering of Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2510.06919v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present a method that models the evolution of an unbounded number of time series clusters by switching among an unknown number of regimes with linear dynamics. We develop a Bayesian non-parametric approach using a hierarchical Dirichlet process as a prior on the parameters of a Switching Linear Dynamical System and a Gaussian process prior to model the statistical variations in amplitude and temporal alignment within each cluster. By modeling the evolution of time series patterns, the method avoids unnecessary proliferation of clusters in a principled manner. We perform inference by formulating a variational lower bound for off-line and on-line scenarios, enabling efficient learning through optimization. We illustrate the versatility and effectiveness of the approach through several case studies of electrocardiogram analysis using publicly available databases.

translated_title: 时间序列的贝叶斯非参数动态聚类
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种方法，通过在未知数量的线性动态机制之间切换，来建模无界数量的时间序列簇的演化。我们开发了一种贝叶斯非参数方法，使用层次狄利克雷过程作为切换线性动态系统（Switching Linear Dynamical System）参数的先验，并使用高斯过程先验来建模每个簇内振幅和时间对齐的统计变化。通过对时间序列模式的演化进行建模，该方法以有原则的方式避免了簇的不必要增殖。我们通过为离线和在线场景制定变分下界来执行推断，从而通过优化实现高效学习。我们通过使用公开数据库进行的多项心电图分析案例研究，展示了该方法的通用性和有效性。
tldr: 提出一种基于层次狄利克雷过程与高斯过程先验的贝叶斯非参数方法，通过在未知数量的线性动态机制间切换来建模时间序列簇的演化，以原则性方式避免簇的无序增殖，并可通过变分推断实现离线与在线的高效学习，在心电图分析中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: A Bayesian nonparametric method using hierarchical Dirichlet process and Gaussian process priors models the evolution of an unbounded number of time series clusters by switching among an unknown number of linear-dynamic regimes, principledly avoiding unnecessary cluster proliferation, with efficient offline and online variational inference demonstrated on ECG analysis.
